research_question: Can an engine-owned resting entry at the causal confirmation boundary preserve resolved-impact direction while recovering the cost-net geometry lost by immediate next-trade market entry?

selection.method: Deterministic SHA-256 ordering of Monday BTC weeks from 2021-01-04 through 2026-07-20, excluding candidate-01 weeks already opened.

rules.fixed_signal_stop_target: candidate v17 causal three-notional resolved impact with base measured target
rules.primary_entry: NautilusTrader limit bracket at confirmation_hold_price; valid for the observed initiative-to-resolution wall-clock duration; cancel if target trades first or expiry occurs
rules.control_entry: first official venue trade strictly after completed resolution
rules.selection_after_first_week: Use boundary-limit whenever it advances. Use market-control only when primary stops and control advances. Freeze selected rule before week two.

execution.data: Official Binance Vision USD-M BTCUSDT aggTrades represented one-for-one as NautilusTrader TradeTick

long_evaluation_gate.prerequisite: All three frozen weeks advance, at least two are full_pass, and pooled three-week NAV geometric daily return is at least 1% before adding a continuous long runner.
long_evaluation_gate.long_run_must_be: One continuous NautilusTrader engine/account/strategy state, never stitched weekly NAV.

invalidation: Do not change signal, stop, target, boundary entry, expiry, cost, risk, weeks or gates after opening a frozen week.
Do not open week two if both first-week entries stop.
Do not open week three if the selected rule stops on week two.
Do not use another instrument or long period to rescue a weekly failure.
